manifest.name: dsh-notice-card
manifest.description: Windows 桌面端专用，没有网页端那一半。在屏幕角落弹出通知卡：任务跑完、等你审批、等你回答的时候提醒你一下。跟随系统深浅色与 DPI，落在鼠标那块屏幕，只有黑底白字和白底黑字两套配色，文字按亮度抗锯齿绘制，不抢焦点。Windows desktop only, no web build: a notice card that appears in a corner of the monitor under your pointer when a turn ends, or when DSH is waiting for an approval or an answer. Follows the system theme and DPI, ships two monochrome palettes (white on black, black on white), draws text with brightness-only anti-aliasing, and never takes focus.

dshhub.summary: 任务跑完、等你审批、等你回答的时候，在屏幕角落弹一张卡提醒你。Windows 桌面端专用，不提供网页端通知。跟随系统主题、DPI 与文本大小，落在鼠标那块屏幕，不抢焦点。

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: dsh-notice-card
      config: {}

readme.text: <div align="center">

给 DeepSeek Harness **桌面端**的通知卡：任务跑完、等你审批、等你回答时，在屏幕角落弹一张卡片。 **只做桌面端。** 卡片是 Windows 原生窗口，不依赖浏览器，也不提供网页端那一套（浏览器通知 / 页面浮层 / 标签页标题标记）。 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notice-card) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notice-card) [](LICENSE) [](#requirements) **简体中文** · [English](https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card/blob/main/README.en.md) [功能](#features) · [安装](#install) · [配置](#config) · [实现](#how) · [常见问题](#faq) · [卸载](#uninstall)

三件事发生时弹一张卡：

- 一轮任务跑完
- 等你审批工具调用
- 等你回答一个问题

卡片盖在其他窗口上，但不抢焦点。你可以继续打字；屏幕被一个程序占满的时候不弹，退出全屏后补上。

- **跟随系统主题** —— 深色模式深底浅字，浅色模式反过来。每次弹卡读一次主题，刚切过之后弹出的卡立刻是新配色。两套都是固定常量：深色 `#2B2B2B` 表面 / `#FFFFFF` 主文字 / `#CFCFCF` 次要文字，浅色 `#FFFFFF` / `#1A1A1A` / `#5F5F5F`——照 Windows「设置」应用实测取的。不再读 uxtheme，它只能给纯黑纯白，给不出设置应用那种浮起表面。
- **高对比度让位** —— 开了高对比度就用系统自己的窗口色和文字色，不猜变体。
- **文字用灰阶抗锯齿画到黑底，再压成纯灰阶上屏** —— 白字画到黑底（按 2 倍采样画，回落后再算覆盖度），读回每个像素的覆盖度，按覆盖度在底色和字色之间插值。不用 ClearType，是因为它把一根竖笔的覆盖度放在一条子像素列上：同一根笔落在红列、绿列、蓝列上亮度能差 5 倍，压成灰度后就是「相邻竖笔一深一浅」，这正是小字看起来不均匀、发糊的原因。灰阶是真正的逐像素面积，竖笔峰值标准差 0.05–0.08（旧方案 0.11–0.13）。2 倍采样让字形轮廓有真实的过渡带，硬跳变占比 0.25–0.28（旧方案 0.44–0.48），边缘不再是一级级台阶。字号只取整数像素，行高和换行宽度都用同一套引擎算，不会一边量得下一边画不下。
- **字体跟界面语言走** —— 中文 Noto Sans SC（回退微软雅黑 UI）、日文 Noto Sans JP / Yu Gothic UI、韩文 Noto Sans KR / Malgun Gothic、其它 Segoe UI。标题取同族更重**一档**的 master（SemiBold，没有就用 Medium），正文用 Regular master，都是字体本来画出来的重，不是把轮廓加厚。只加一档：Black 标题在这个字号下是糊不是粗，Medium 正文会把每根竖笔都加宽到看起来像加粗。从右往左的语言（阿拉伯语、希伯来语）右上角两个按钮镜像到左上角。
- **正文框按行数定，能放六行** —— 卡片高度不随正文长短伸缩：六行是常数，短正文下方留白。这样一叠卡高度一致、边缘齐平，每张卡算出来的「这里能放几张」也一致。行距是 1.4 倍字身（字体自带行盒是 1.45，按它排一段话显散），取整数像素，第十行仍落在第一行预测的位置。
- **描边是上淡下重的方向边** —— 卡片被圆角 `Region` 裁掉，阴影画不进窗口里，所以浮起感靠一圈 1px 竖渐变：上沿接近表面色，下沿压到近黑，四边同一圈渐变。这比四面一样重的发丝边更像一张纸，也不会在深色卡上出现「白边」那种一眼假的玻璃感。渐变是对外圈圆角矩形填色、再把表面挖回去做出来的，不是用渐变笔描边——GDI+ 的渐变笔只肯在一段路径上给色，描一圈会有三条边是空的。

- **落在鼠标那块屏幕** —— 副屏不跑丢。`corner: auto` 跟系统通知同一个角：任务栏在下面就在右下，在上面就在右上，在左边就跟到左下。
- **也可以钉死四角** —— `top-left` / `top-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-right`。上边两个顶格贴屏幕顶，下边两个贴任务栏上沿，按工作区算，任务栏在左边或上边也一样对齐。
- **按屏幕宽度缩放** —— 小屏笔记本上不会盖掉三分之一桌面，4K 上也不会缩成邮票。字号有下限。
- **跟文本大小一起长** —— 「设置 → 辅助功能 → 文本大小」调过，整张卡放大，不把文字挤进原来的框。
- **叠成一摞** —— 最早那张在最前、完整显示，后面的只露标题。放得下几张叠几张，绝不会有一张落到屏幕外。

叠成一摞时每张卡只露出贴着屏幕边的那一条窄带，所以弹出时刻、会话名和卡片标题永远一起写在**那条窄带上**：卡片落在下边两个角，窄带是卡片最上面两行（第一行时钟在前，`14:37 · 会话名`，会话没标题时显示会话 id 前 6 位；第二行是标题）；卡片落在上边两个角，窄带在卡片底部，这两行就写在最下面。窄带的高度按这两行实际占的空间算，所以字调大、卡变宽变窄，三样都还在。右到左的语言里整条跟着镜像。

- **时刻** —— 按系统的短时间格式（12 小时制 `2:35 PM`，24 小时制 `14:35`）。
- **会话名** —— 和时刻同一行，从时刻后面一直排到那一行右端的两个按钮为止，太长就截断成 `...`。
- **权限范围** —— 跟应用里那个下拉条同名，只显示不可点，写在离窄带最远的那一行，完全展开时才看得到。

- **不抢焦点** —— 焦点留在你原来那个窗口，打字、放视频都不受影响。
- **全屏时一张卡都不画，退出后补上** —— D3D 独占、演示模式，以及已经拿走呈现路径的无边框全屏游戏都算。在这种画面上让任何窗口出现或消失，合成器都得退出那条路径重新合成：屏幕白闪一下、画面掉一帧、鼠标指针弹出来。所以全屏期间不建窗，通知排进队列等着；退出全屏后按到达顺序一张张补弹，卡与卡之间留出间隔，不会一次糊满屏幕。中途又进全屏，已经弹出的卡自己收掉，队列继续等。全屏期间一直不弹的也没有丢：审批卡和提问卡的请求还在 DSH 自己窗口里，任务结束卡会一直等到你退出全屏。
- **免打扰时不打扰** —— 系统进「请勿打扰」（专注模式、演示模式）时任务结束卡不弹；审批卡和提问卡照弹，那是对话在等你。
- **关动画就真不动** —— 系统关掉「在 Windows 中显示动画」或进省电模式，卡片直接落到位置，不滑入淡出。每张卡判断一次，中途改设置下一张就换行为。
- **按钮尺寸跟那一行** —— 按钮高度取时间戳行的行高（最小 16 单位），所以两种布局里都和时钟一般高，不会比那一行更高、吊在行外面。触摸屏上不做悬停高亮，滚轮行数读系统鼠标设置，不是写死三行。
- **压在最上层** —— 跟别的置顶窗口抢顶层时可能被挤到后面，这是正常的。

- **任务结束卡** —— 停留 `seconds` 秒后淡出，不点也会消失。 - **审批卡和提问卡** —— 不自己消失。请求可能在你没看见时就被答掉了（回合中止、审批策略自动拒绝、远程客户端替你答），卡片跟着消失会让你以为对话卡住。所以必须同时满足「请求已答完」和「DSH 窗口在这前后出现在过最前面」才淡出，最少显示 1.2 秒，不会闪一下就没了。 - **点 ✕** —— 立即收起。点窗口图标则把 DSH 切到前台。 - **超出叠放上限** —— 最早那张被新卡关掉。

> **只做桌面端，不做网页端。** 卡片是画在运行 DSH 的那台 Windows 机器桌面上的原生窗口，不经过浏览器。包里没有网页那一半，所以浏览器通知、页面浮层、标签页标题标记这些一个都没有。想在浏览器里收提醒，用 [dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me) 那种带 client 半的网页插件。 | 项目 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | 形态 | **桌面端**（`DeepSeek Harness.exe`），或 DSH 宿主就跑在你要看的那台 Windows 上 | | 系统 | Windows | | DSH | 0.1.0-rc.1 或更高 | | Node | 20 或更高（只在 DSH 加载插件时用得到） | | .NET Framework | 4.x，Windows 自带，不用另外装 | 浏览器只用来操作 DSH 的话，卡片会画在 DSH 宿主那台机器上。宿主在远程服务器上，卡片就落在服务器的桌面，你在这边看不见。
四种方式，按你的 DSH 是哪种形态选一种。**不要同时用两种**，否则每件事弹两张卡。

```bash
npm i dsh-notice-card@0.3.1
```

在 profile 目录的 `cordis.patch.yml`（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile 名>\`）末尾加上：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/你执行 npm i 的目录/node_modules/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config: {}

`name:` 要写完整绝对路径，斜杠用 `/`。

想改代码就用这种。

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.1 https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card.git
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/你克隆的目录/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config: {}

新加的 `id` 会被 DSH 立即加载，不用重启。没有反应就完全退出 DSH 再打开。

桌面端的 `desktop` profile 由应用自己管理，命令行的 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` 会被拒绝。

在应用里打开 **设置 → 插件**，填仓库地址：

```
Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card
```

装完自动挂上，不用改 patch 文件。

```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-notice-card@0.3.1 ``` 也可以直接走 GitHub 源，不经 npm： ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card#v0.3.1 ``` 包里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 会被自动加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。 这种方式只适合宿主也跑在本机的场合。宿主跑在远程服务器上，装到哪个 profile 都一样：卡片画在服务器的桌面上。

配置写在 patch 的 `config:` 里。比如只关掉「任务结束」提示、把停留时间改成 20 秒：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/你克隆的目录/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config:

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTurnEnd` | `true` | 一轮任务结束时弹卡 |
| `onApproval` | `true` | 等你审批工具调用时弹卡 |
| `onQuestion` | `true` | 等你回答问题时弹卡 |
| `seconds` | `10` | 任务结束卡停留几秒。审批卡和提问卡不看这个值 |
| `turnEndTitle` | `任务已结束` | 任务结束卡的标题 |
| `turnEndBody` | `DSH 已完成本轮任务，等你下一步。` | 任务结束卡的正文 |
| `approvalTitle` | `等你审批` | 审批卡的标题 |
| `approvalBody` | `工具：{tool}{reason}` | 审批卡正文模板。`{tool}` 工具名，`{reason}` 审批理由 |
| `questionTitle` | `等你回答` | 提问卡的标题 |
| `questionBody` | `问题：{question}` | 提问卡正文模板。`{question}` 问题内容 |
| `processName` | 自动推断 | 点窗口图标时切到哪个进程 |
| `appPath` | 自动推断 | 那个进程没开时启动哪个 exe |
| `corner` | `auto` | `auto` 跟任务栏走，或钉死 `top-left` / `top-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-right` |
| `maxStack` | `3` | 最多同时显示几张卡（1–8），超出关掉最老的。实际张数还受屏幕高度限制 |
| `fontSize` | `100` | 字号百分比（80–160）。只放大字，卡片的宽、高、行距与各段位置都不变 |
| `theme` | `auto` | `auto` 跟系统深浅色，或钉死 `light` / `dark`。浅色是白底黑字，深色是黑底白字 |
| `animations` | `follow` | `follow` 跟系统动画开关，或钉死 `on` / `off` |
| `scale` | `auto` | `auto` 按屏宽取 17.5%，或写百分比（`"60"`–`"200"`，也认旧写法 `"1.25"`）。`100` 就是这块屏幕自己会选的大小 |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto` 跟系统语言，或钉死 `zh` / `en`，决定文案与字体 |
| `contrast` | `50` | 对比度 `"0"`–`"100"`，`50` 是不动。也认 `auto` / `high`（=100）/ `soft`（=0） |

`processName` 和 `appPath` 默认从 DSH 进程推出来，桌面端下就是 `DeepSeek Harness` 和它的 exe 路径。两个都留空，点窗口图标只关卡片、不切窗口。

这些键全在 **设置 → 通知卡** 里有控件，改完下一张卡就按新值画，不用重启。直接写 patch 的 `config:` 属于改已有配置，要**完全退出 DSH 再启动**才读得到。

设置页改任何一项都会在你桌面右下角（或当前角落）起一叠预览卡，按当前设置画，改一下就跟着变：缩放、字号和对比度拖滑块，拖到哪张卡片就变到哪；滑块旁边的数字可以直接敲，范围写死在那里。每角最多几张拖数字，能直接看出改的是哪里。关掉设置页预览就收走。

预览卡是「任务结束 / 等你审批 / 等你回答」各一张，按上面三个开关来。点哪张就关掉哪张，空出来的位置立刻补一张另外的种类，所以你关几次都还是一叠三张；三个开关全取消勾选，三张就都换成空白卡，页眉依次写「第一张」「第二张」「第三张」，时间戳也各差一分钟，好让三张空白卡看起来仍是三张。第一张就在角落上、整张摊开，后面出现的往远离角落的方向一张张压上来，编号和时间也照着这个顺序走：贴着角落那张最早，越往外越晚。

这叠预览卡由一个常驻的预览进程画，不是每改一次就新开一个进程：进程起来要 300ms 上下，而在这个进程里重画一叠只要 40ms 上下，所以设置页只把当前设置写进一个小文件，那个进程看到就当场重画。

重画是逐张来的，不是整叠换掉。几何没变的卡原地保留，换主题时从左上角到右下角扫过一道（旧配色盖在上面，沿对角线退场）。每角最多几张往上加时，新卡从前一张后面滑出来，看得出它是从哪儿来的；往下减就直接收走。
对比度不属于换配色：它只挪正文和页眉页脚的墨色深浅，卡面本身不动，所以拖动时不扫那道，字一直在，只是颜色一路变深或变浅。这道扫过只留给纸面真的换了的时候（浅色换深色），否则每拖一格都把字盖住一下，等于盯着卡反复变空白。

- **三个事件** —— `agent/turn-stopping`（一轮结束）、`approval/request`（等你审批）、`user-questions/request`（等你回答）。
- **只弹卡，不代替你回答** —— 审批和提问的监听器挂在最前面，卡片弹出后立刻调 `next()`，把请求交回原本的应答方（应用里的面板）。你还是在应用里作答，卡片盯着请求，答完就收走。
- **底部两行从宿主读** —— 会话名走 `sessionTitle`（没标题退回会话 id 前 6 位），权限名走 `permissionPresets` 的预设目录。任一服务读不到就不写那行，卡片照常弹。
- **其余全是当场读的系统状态** —— 主题 `AppsUseLightTheme`、高对比度、动画开关 `SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION`、省电 `GetSystemPowerStatus`、文本大小 `TextScaleFactor`、触摸 `SM_DIGITIZER`、滚轮行数 `SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES`、任务栏在哪边、界面语言、免打扰 `SHQueryUserNotificationState`。任何一项读不到都退回安全默认值，不会因此不弹卡。
- **每个角是独立队列** —— 卡片文件名带角标签（`-br` / `-tl`），不同角的卡互不计数。
- **一次一进程** —— 每张卡是独立的 `card-<校验和>.exe` 进程，没有常驻进程。一张卡崩了只崩它自己。从起进程到出现在屏幕上约 100ms；第一次还要先编译一次 exe，多约 150ms。
- **全屏时排队而不是丢弃** —— 排队的卡不建窗，进程留一个 `<到达时刻>-<pid>.wait` 文件在原地等，屏幕空出来才按到达顺序建窗。等的时候一个窗口都没有，所以游戏画面不会被它打断。等待没有时限，会话结束就一起退出。
- **动画** —— 4ms 一帧的私有消息泵，不是 `WM_TIMER`，180Hz 屏上也是连续滑动。
- **编译一次就复用** —— `lib/card.cs` 第一次弹卡时用系统自带的 `csc.exe` 编成 exe，存到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-notice-card\`。源码内容变了才重编。

```powershell $card = (Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\dsh-notice-card\card-*.exe" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName & $card --title "标题" --body "正文" --seconds 8 --corner top-left --session "演示" --preset "工作区内修改" ``` 前提是缓存目录里已经有一个 `card-*.exe`，没有就先随便跑一轮 DSH 任务让它编一次。`--corner`、`--max-stack`、`--session`、`--preset` 都可以省略。

**在浏览器里用 DSH，能收到卡片吗**

收不到。卡片画在跑 DSH 的那台 Windows 机器上，不经过浏览器。`dsh web` 开在另一台设备上，或者宿主在远程服务器上，卡片都落在宿主那台机器的桌面，你看不见。想在浏览器里收提醒，换 [dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me) 这类带网页端一半的插件。

**卡片不弹**

1. 用上面那条命令单独跑一次。能弹说明卡片本身是好的，问题在插件没挂上
2. 检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `name:` 的路径是否存在，结尾是不是 `lib/index.mjs`
3. 改了 patch 没反应：DSH 只对**新增的 `id`** 热加载，改已有的 `id` 要完全退出 DSH 再打开
4. 只弹一张、后面的不弹：检查是不是用两种方式挂了两次

**玩游戏的时候一张都不弹**

这是有意的，不是坏了。全屏时让任何窗口出现或消失都会让画面白闪一下、掉一帧、把鼠标指针弹出来，所以那段时间不建窗，通知排队等着；退出全屏后按到达顺序一张张补上，等多久都不丢。想看回放就把游戏切成窗口化，或者退出全屏。 **中文变成乱码** `lib/card.cs` 是 UTF-8 无 BOM 的源码，编译时按文件里的字面量来。乱码一般是编辑器先按 GBK 读、又按 UTF-8 存回去，把中文压坏了。用 VS Code 以「UTF-8 without BOM」重新打开、保存即可。 **想改卡片的样子** 颜色、字号、圆角、动画时长、叠放间距都在 `lib/card.cs` 里。改完不用重装，文件内容一改，下次弹卡自动重编。

1. 删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那段 `- insert:`（方式一、二、四），或在 **设置 → 插件** 里卸载（方式三）
2. 删掉缓存目录 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-notice-card\`
3. 顺带删掉 `node_modules/dsh-notice-card`（方式一）或克隆出来的目录（方式二）
- 不发网络请求，不写统计 - 不收集你的路径、用户名、会话内容 - 跟 DSH 的交互只有那三个事件。卡片上显示的只有事件自带的工具名和问题文本 - 编译出来的 exe 放在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-notice-card\`，卸载时一起删掉

有 Bug、有想法，到 [Issues](https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card/issues) 提。

附上：Windows 版本、DSH 版本、是哪种卡片（任务结束 / 审批 / 提问）、复现步骤。有截图或录屏最好。

Notification cards for the DeepSeek Harness **desktop app**: when a turn ends, when DSH waits for an approval, or when it waits for an answer, a card appears in a corner of the screen.

**Desktop only.** The card is a native Windows window and needs no browser. There is no web half: no browser notifications, no in-page overlay, no tab-title marker.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notice-card)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notice-card)
[](LICENSE)
[](#requirements)

[简体中文](https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card/blob/main/README.md) · **English** [Features](#features) · [Install](#install) · [Config](#config) · [How it works](#how) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Uninstall](#uninstall)

A card appears when one of three things happens:

- A turn finishes
- DSH waits for you to approve a tool call
- DSH waits for you to answer a question

The card sits above other windows but never takes focus. You can keep typing; while one program owns the whole screen nothing is drawn, and it is raised once you leave fullscreen.

- **Follows the system theme** — dark surface with light text on dark, the other way round on light. The theme is read once per card, so a card raised after you switch already has the new colours. Both sets are fixed constants — dark `#2B2B2B` surface / `#FFFFFF` primary / `#CFCFCF` secondary, light `#FFFFFF` / `#1A1A1A` / `#5F5F5F` — measured off the Windows Settings app. uxtheme is no longer consulted: it only ever answers pure black or pure white, and cannot give the raised surface Settings actually uses.
- **High contrast takes over** — with high contrast on, the card borrows the system's own window and text colours instead of guessing at a variant.
- **Text is drawn with greyscale antialiasing into a black buffer, then flattened** — white on black into a scratch buffer at twice the card's pixel size, then every pixel's coverage is read back and interpolated between the surface colour and the ink colour. ClearType is not used: it parks a stem's coverage on one subpixel column, so the same stroke reads five times brighter or darker depending on which column it landed on, and after flattening to grey that is exactly what "neighbouring stems disagree" looks like at small sizes. Gr

- **Lands on the monitor under the pointer** — a second screen does not lose the card. `corner: auto` copies the shell: a bottom taskbar keeps cards bottom-right, a top one moves them top-right, a left one sends them bottom-left.
- **Or pin one of four corners** — `top-left` / `top-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-right`. The top two sit flush with the screen edge, the bottom two rest on the taskbar, computed from the working area so a left or top taskbar lines up too.
- **Scales with the monitor width** — no card covering a third of a small laptop, no postage stamp on a 4K wall. Text has a floor.
- **Grows with the text size** — bump **Settings → Accessibility → Text size** and the whole card grows instead of squeezing the text into the old box.
- **Stacks into a deck** — the oldest card sits in front and fully visible, the rest show only their title. As many as fit, and never one off the edge of the screen.

In a deck each card shows only the narrow band against the screen edge, so the moment, the session name and the card's headline all live in that band: with the card in one of the two bottom corners the band is the card's top two rows (the moment first, `14:37 · session name`, with the session id's first six characters when there is no generated title yet, then the headline); in the top corners the band is at the bottom, so the same two rows are the last ones. The band is measured from those two rows, so it keeps holding all three however large the type or however wide the card. Right-to-left languages mirror the whole strip.

- **The moment** — in your own short-time pattern (`2:35 PM` on a 12-hour region, `14:35` on a 24-hour one).
- **The session name** — on the same row as the moment, running from behind it to the two buttons at that row's right end, truncated with `...` when long.
- **The permission mode** — the same name the app's permission dropdown shows, display only, written on the row furthest from the band so it shows when the card is fully expanded.

- **Never takes focus** — focus stays in the window you were using. Typing and video playback are unaffected.
- **Nothing is drawn while a game owns the screen, and it is raised afterwards** — D3D exclusive, presentation mode, and borderless games that have taken the presentation path all count. Letting any window appear or disappear over such a surface forces the compositor to leave that path and rebuild: the screen goes white for a frame, a frame is dropped, and the mouse cursor pops out mid-fight. So no window is built while it lasts; notices queue up instead and are raised one at a time, in arrival order, once the screen is free again, with a gap between them so the desktop is not buried. Go fullscreen again and the cards already up take themselves down while the queue keeps waiting. Nothing waiting is lost: approval and question requests are still in DSH's own window, and a turn-end card waits as long as it takes for you to leave fullscreen.
- **Quiet hours suppress the interruption** — while Windows is in a do-not-disturb state (focus assist, presentation mode) a turn-end card is not drawn. Approval and question cards still appear: that is the conversation waiting on you.
- *

- **Turn-end card** — fades out after `seconds`, no click needed.
- **Approval and question cards** — never expire on their own. A request can be settled while you never saw the card (a stopped turn, an auto-deny policy, a remote client answering for you), and a card that vanished with it would make the conversation look stuck. So it fades out only when the request has been answered **and** the DSH window has been in front around that moment, with a 1.2 second minimum so it never flashes away.
- **Click ✕** — dismiss immediately. Click the window icon to bring DSH to the front.
- **Past the stack cap** — the oldest card is closed by the arriving one.

> **Desktop only, no web build.** The card is a native window drawn on the Windows machine running DSH, not through a browser. The package has no web half, so browser notifications, in-page overlays and tab-title markers are all absent. For browser-side reminders, use a plugin that ships a client half, such as [dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me).

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Form | **The desktop app** (`DeepSeek Harness.exe`), or a DSH host running on the Windows machine you look at |
| OS | Windows |
| DSH | 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer |
| Node | 20 or newer (only used when DSH loads the plugin) |
| .NET Framework | 4.x, ships with Windows, nothing to install |
If you only drive DSH from a browser, the card still draws on the machine that hosts DSH. With the host on a remote server, the card lands on that server's desktop and you never see it.
Four ways. Pick the one that matches your DSH setup, and **do not use two at once**, or every event draws two cards.

```bash
npm i dsh-notice-card@0.3.1
```

Then add this at the end of `cordis.patch.yml` in your profile directory (by default `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile name>\`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/the directory where you ran npm i/node_modules/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config: {}

`name:` must be a full absolute path, with `/` as the separator.

Use this one if you want to change the code.

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.1 https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card.git
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/the directory you cloned into/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config: {}

DSH loads a newly added `id` immediately, no restart needed. If nothing happens, quit DSH completely and open it again.

The desktop app manages its own `desktop` profile, so the command-line `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` is refused there.

In the app, open **Settings → Plugins** and enter the repository:

```
Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card
```

It mounts automatically afterwards; you do not edit the patch file.

readme.section: Option 4: a profile you created yourself
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add dsh-notice-card@0.3.1
```

You can also use the GitHub source instead of npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card#v0.3.1
```

The `dsh.bundle.patch` field in the package is added to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` for you.

readme.section: Option 4: a profile you created yourself
readme.text: This option only helps when the host runs on this same machine. With the host on a remote server, it makes no difference which profile you install into: the card draws on the server's desktop.

Configuration goes in the patch's `config:` block. For example, to turn off the turn-end notice and keep it up for 20 seconds:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notice-card
      name: C:/the directory you cloned into/dsh-notice-card/lib/index.mjs
      config:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTurnEnd` | `true` | Draw a card when a turn finishes |
| `onApproval` | `true` | Draw a card when DSH waits for a tool approval |
| `onQuestion` | `true` | Draw a card when DSH waits for an answer |
| `seconds` | `10` | How many seconds the turn-end card stays. Approval and question cards ignore it |
| `turnEndTitle` | `任务已结束` | Title of the turn-end card |
| `turnEndBody` | `DSH 已完成本轮任务，等你下一步。` | Body of the turn-end card |
| `approvalTitle` | `等你审批` | Title of the approval card |
| `approvalBody` | `工具：{tool}{reason}` | Body template. `{tool}` is the tool name, `{reason}` the approval reason |
| `questionTitle` | `等你回答` | Title of the question card |
| `questionBody` | `问题：{question}` | Body template. `{question}` is the question text |
| `processName` | inferred | Which process to switch to when you click the window icon |
| `appPath` | inferred | Which exe to launch when that process is not running |
| `corner` | `auto` | `auto` follows the taskbar, or pin `top-left` / `top-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-right` |
| `maxStack` | `3` | How many cards may be up at once (1–8); the oldest closes past that. The screen height stil

`processName` and `appPath` are inferred from the DSH process; on the desktop app they are `DeepSeek Harness` and its exe path. Leave both empty and clicking the window icon only closes the card. Changing `corner`, `maxStack` or `fontSize` edits the config of an already-loaded plugin, so it takes a **full DSH restart**, not a reload.

- **Three events** — `agent/turn-stopping` (turn finished), `approval/request` (waiting for approval), `user-questions/request` (waiting for an answer).
- **It draws, it does not answer for you** — the approval and question listeners sit at the front, and the card calls `next()` right away, handing the request back to the panel that answers it in the app. The answer stays yours to give there; the card watches the request and leaves once it is answered.
- **The footer reads from the host** — the session name comes from `sessionTitle` (falling back to the first six characters of the id), the permission name from the preset catalogue behind `permissionPresets`. If a service is unavailable its line is simply not written and the card still appears.
- **Everything else is read from the system per card** — the theme (`AppsUseLightTheme`), high contrast, the animation setting (`SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION`), battery saver (`GetSystemPowerStatus`), the text scale (`TextScaleFactor`), touch input (`SM_DIGITIZER`), the wheel scroll lines (`SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES`), which edge the taskbar is on, the interface language and the do-not-disturb state (`SHQueryUserNotificationState`). readme.section: Try a card on its own
readme.text: ```powershell $card = (Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\dsh-notice-card\card-*.exe" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName & $card --title "Title" --body "Body" --seconds 8 --corner top-left --session "demo" --preset "workspace-write" ``` This needs a `card-*.exe` to already exist in the cache directory; if there is none, run one DSH turn to trigger the first compile. `--corner`, `--max-stack`, `--session` and `--preset` are all optional.

**I use DSH from a browser. Will I get cards?**

No. The card is drawn on the Windows machine that runs DSH, not through a browser. With `dsh web` open on another device, or the host on a remote server, the card lands on the host's desktop and you never see it. For browser-side reminders, use a plugin that ships a web half, such as [dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me).

**No card appears**

1. Run the command above to draw a card on its own. If that works, the card is fine and the plugin is not mounted
2. Check that the path in `cordis.patch.yml` `name:` exists and ends in `lib/index.mjs`
3. You edited the patch and nothing happened: DSH hot-loads only **newly added `id`s**. Changing an existing `id` takes a full restart
4. Only one card appears and later ones do not: check whether you mounted the plugin two ways

**Nothing appears while I am playing**

That is deliberate, not a fault. A window appearing or disappearing over a full-screen game makes the picture flash white, drop a frame and pop the cursor out, so none is built while the screen is taken: the notices queue up instead and are raised in arrival order once you leave fullscreen, however long that takes. To see them, switch the game to windowed or drop out of fullscreen.

**Chinese text turns into garbage**

`lib/card.cs` is UTF-8 source without a BOM, and the compiler takes literals from the file as they are. Garbage usually means an editor read the file as GBK and wrote it back as UTF-8. Reopen it in VS Code, save as "UTF-8 without BOM", and it is back to normal.

**I want to change how the card looks**

Colours, font sizes, corner radius, animation length and stacking gap are all in `lib/card.cs`. No reinstall needed: once the file content changes, the next card recompiles automatically.

1. Delete the `- insert:` block from `cordis.patch.yml` (options 1, 2, 4), or uninstall from **Settings → Plugins** (option 3)
2. Delete the cache directory `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-notice-card\`
3. Optionally delete `node_modules/dsh-notice-card` (option 1) or the cloned directory (option 2)

- No network requests, no statistics - No collection of your paths, user name or conversation content - The only interaction with DSH is the three events above. A card shows only the tool name and question text those events carry - The compiled exe lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-notice-card\`, deleted along with it on uninstall

Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue at [Issues](https://github.com/Maple-Yoli/dsh-notice-card/issues).

Please include your Windows version, DSH version, which card it was (turn end / approval / question) and the steps to reproduce. A screenshot or recording is best.
